source.test: resolvedActiveSlotID(forServerDir:) — explicit marker naming a nonexistent slot

notes: active_slot_id.txt names slot-ghost, which does not appear in the loaded slots list -- e.g. it was deleted, or the marker was copied in from a different server/import source. `slots.contains(where: { $0.id == explicit })` at line 133 fails, so the `if let explicit = ...` branch (lines 132-135) never returns, and resolution falls through to the most-recently-played branch (lines 137-141), which picks slot-b over slot-a by lastPlayedAt. This is the same code path exercised by a genuinely missing/empty active_slot_id.txt (loadExplicitActiveSlotID returns nil either way), which is why Phase 6's reconciliation rule treats 'marker present but stale' and 'marker absent' identically -- see world-import-reconciliation/missing-or-corrupt-active-marker-with-live-and-slots.json.
